items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I don't really know, but I was thinking... I read an article where they said how Grambling came about was that -- it was a white man's name, and a couple of black people got together and called Booker T. Washington

ctx.x: And I read an article where they said how Grambling came about was that -- it was a white man's name, and a couple

of black people got together and called Booker T. Washington and they corresponded with one another then, who was at Tuskegee, and told them that they wanted to start a college there in Louisiana called Grambling College, and Booker T. sent someone down from Tuskegee, so now they said -- this seems like it was 1908 -- so you know, I don't know if he sent the Professor down then, so they must have had something to ...
New Orleans University was a black university?
